kjv: the fir trees shall be terribly shaken (KJV 2:3)
note: haberoshim "the cypresses" here are spear-shafts made of cypress wood, brandished by the attacking army, not trees shaking.

kjv: And Huzzab shall be led away captive (KJV 2:7)
mine: it is decreed: she is stripped
note: hutsav is a Hophal verb "it is fixed/decreed" (or an epithet of the queen or city), not a personal name Huzzab.
